candidate.answerReason: Similar triangles give FD:FA=4:16=1:4. Their sum is AD=BC=10, so FD=2.

methods.label: Use the parallel sides to find a ratio
methods.explanation:
The parallel sides of the parallelogram make the two triangles meeting at \(F\) similar. Since \(DE\parallel AB\), we have \(\angle EDF=\angle BAF\). Also, \(\angle EFD=\angle BFA\) because they are vertical angles. Thus \(\triangle EDF\sim\triangle BAF\).

Corresponding sides therefore satisfy
\[
\frac{FD}{FA}=\frac{DE}{AB}=\frac4{16}=\frac14.
\]
So \(FD:FA=1:4\). Opposite sides of a parallelogram are equal, giving \(AD=BC=10\). Since \(F\) lies between \(A\) and \(D\), the five equal parts together have length \(10\). Hence
\[
FD=\frac{10}{1+4}=2.
\]
The closest listed value is exactly \(2\), choice \(\boxed{\text{B}}\).
